result.question: What is the man of God's answer to the prophet?

readings.answer: I cannot go home with you, and I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
readings.support: I cannot go home with you, and I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

assessments.reason: In verse 15 the prophet invites him, and in verse 16 “the man replied, ‘I cannot go home with you, and I will not eat bread or drink water with you in this place,’” which matches the key’s paraphrase “I am not allowed to go.”

In verse 14 the prophet asks, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” and he answers, “I am,” which is also an answer to the prophet within the same window, though it is not the one chosen by the key.

result.reason: The prophet asks two things in the passage and the man of God gives two answers (“I am” and “I cannot go…”), so the question allows more than one materially different answer.
